title: Owner drags a work order to another technician on Board View and clears the outgoing lead shifts
custom_preconds:
Signed in as Admin, viewport at least 1280 px wide.
Saved Work Orders view reset over the API (display List, no layout keys). Technicians A and B pinned in the saved preference.
A work order for a unique customer with lead technician A and one line authorized for repair.
A whole-work-order shift for A on that work order, tomorrow 05:00 shop time.
A line-level shift for A on the authorized line, tomorrow 07:00 shop time.

custom_steps_separated.content: Open Work Orders, pick Board View, and search for the unique customer.
custom_steps_separated.expected: The card is in A's column; A's count is 1 and B's is 0.

custom_steps_separated.content: Drag the card onto B's column and release.
custom_steps_separated.expected: The prompt "Clear <A's full name>'s scheduled shifts?" opens with Keep shifts, Clear shifts and Cancel.
The prompt closes, "Lead technician updated" shows, the card is in B's column, and the counts read A 0, B 1.
Board View reopens with the card in B's column.
The whole-work-order shift is gone; the line-level shift still exists, unchanged.
